## Teaching points

1. Prior surgery and a transition point support adhesive obstruction, but do not exclude strangulation.
2. Fasting, IV replacement of losses and decompression accompany surgical assessment.
3. New continuous pain, peritonitis or instability warrants urgent reassessment rather than continued routine observation.
